protocol.small_face_branch: Clipped planar-area sampling below projected integral 1e-5, matching area-to-solid-angle PDF; no dropped samples

protocol.region_coordinate_convention: Display pixels [x0,y0,x1,y1), top-left origin; intersect receiver mask

algorithms.baseline: Original emissive-strength mass, cosine upper bound, inverse clamped squared distance; uniform bounding-sphere cone conditional.
algorithms.cube: Choose visible hemisphere-clipped cube faces by projected solid angle, then cosine-weighted polygon sampling with two inverse refinements. Below H=1e-5, use clipped planar-area sampling and the matching Jacobian; tiny-face selection weight uses area-centroid quadrature.
algorithms.weights: Mass is average decoded emission luminance from a 4x4 grid on each of six atlas faces, floored at original mass*1e-6. Geometry uses uniform projected-extent mean positive height, normalized by sqrt(distance^2+radius^2/3), divided by distance^2+radius^2/3; cosine floor 0.001. Unary nodes skip scoring but consume the same random value.
algorithms.lookahead: Existing two-level descendant score sum at every binary traversal step; still advances one tree level per draw.
algorithms.rng: Original PCG per pixel/frame sequence; no ReSTIR, BRDF mixture, RIS, sequence replacement or visibility guidance.

timing_acceptance.cohort_shift_rule: Compare rerun medians with original runs whose voxel-build sentinel is within 10% of the accepted scene median. Flag >25% shifts as inconclusive; retain all observed timing ranges.

limitations: 32-frame sample variance is not MSE against a converged reference.
Brightness regions use a shared pooled mean blurred by two pixels; they are diagnostic masks, not ground truth.
Two forward/reverse timing runs per configuration; inspect their ranges, especially noisy BRDF and emission-build timings.
The corridor has unexplained cross-cohort timing shifts despite a stable voxel-build sentinel; its absolute speed comparisons are inconclusive.
Tree-weight candidate combines texture-energy quadrature and finite-extent geometry; this matrix does not isolate them.
Projected-solid-angle inversion uses two refinement iterations; tiny slivers use clipped planar-area sampling with its own PDF.
BRDF does not need the light tree; its reported initial-pass timing excludes the diagnostic tree builds retained by the experiment.
